title: Fisher's Jig
author: Tom Hinds
problems: Row 2 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 3 "robins start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 4 "larks long swing alternates between robins and larks." can't start from where the dancers are: A swing pairs a lark with a robin.
Row 5 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 5 "partners balance & swing · swing" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A long swing is drawn as an ordinary swing.
